title: Validation rules: an authored rule message cannot name record values, so a refusal cannot say "total 8,000 is below received 10,000"
body:
repo:hotcrm#1 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAk8tegvAi1ECkgCFfc

Filing gate ③ (maintainer-directed) · Source: maintainer — Irene chose 「先合并，提示写字段名」 on the hotcrm project thread's decision card (2026-11-27T10:33Z), whose option filed this platform card. Measured while building hotcrm#2827 (PR hotcrm#2836). · Type: Feature · Grade: left to objectstack triage.

## Today

A `validations[]` rule's `message` is returned as written (or its translation) with no parameters. On objectstack main f7f9345e5a, `packages/objectql/src/validation/rule-validator.ts` `authoredRuleMessage(rule, messages)` (~L4106) returns `rule.message` or the catalog translation verbatim; nothing interpolates values from the record being judged. 18.6.0 behaves the same (`checkPredicate` → `authoredRuleMessage`).

So a business rule can refuse a write but cannot tell the person by how much. HotCRM#2827 refuses re-confirming a sales order whose Total Price is below what was already received or invoiced. The approved card asked for "Order SO-0012's total 8,000.00 is below what was received (10,000.00)". The shipped message can only name the fields: "This order's Total Price is below what was already received (Received)…". HotCRM's `contract_same_account` rule on the order records the same limit.

## Ask

Let an authored rule message reference values of the judged record, for example `{total_price}` / `{received_amount}` placeholders (or a `messageParams` map of field → expression), resolved against the same merged record the rule judged and rendered with the field's display format (currency, number, lookup name), in the translated message too. A missing or masked field (no read permission) renders empty, never its raw value.

Who benefits: every app with money or quantity rules (credit limits, quotas, stock, refunds). The person sees the figure to fix without opening another tab.

Dedupe: searched `validation message interpolation record values`, `validation rule message params placeholders` (open and closed), 0 hits on this mechanism. Related but different, closed: #28052 (state_machine message cannot name the refused move), #14253 (custom validation messages had no bundle key).

Consumer: hotcrm#2827 adds the amounts to its two messages (`reconfirm_total_below_received`, `reconfirm_total_below_invoiced` in `src/o2c/extensions/sales-order.extension.ts`) once a pinned release carries this.
